sources.title: Per capita consumption-based CO2 emissions
sources.publisher: Our World in Data / Global Carbon Project

sources.title: 1.5-Degree Lifestyles
sources.publisher: International Institute for Global Environmental Strategies (IGES)

globalAverage.methodology: Consumption-based fossil-fuel and industrial CO2 emissions per capita, adjusted for trade; excludes land-use change and international aviation/shipping from country totals.
globalAverage.accountingBoundary: Global consumption-based fossil CO2 per person; not a household all-gas CO2e lifestyle footprint.

temperatureBudget.methodology: Equity-based per-capita lifestyle target for 2030 from Akenji et al. (2021).
temperatureBudget.accountingBoundary: Consumption-based household lifestyle footprint; excludes public-sector emissions and capital investment. Treat as methodology-specific, not a universal personal carbon budget.
temperatureBudget.allocationRule: Equity-based allocation of the remaining global carbon budget across the global population, as described by the source.
gases: Greenhouse gases expressed as CO2e; gas-by-gas scope must be confirmed from the cited report.
